note: This is the honest accuracy estimate for the real Kaggle dataset. The naive 100% figure from a plain 80/20 split is inflated by data leakage: the source file duplicates each of only 304 unique cases up to 90 times, so a random split places copies of the same case in both train and test. This evaluation deduplicates first, then uses stratified k-fold cross-validation so every prediction is made on a truly unseen case.
